Back to the station finder

Finding a relevant notice,
without inventing an offer.

Station Points uses the Apache-2.0 multilingual MiniLM model in a quantized ONNX conversion. It embeds Japanese notices and an English or Japanese query, then ranks notices by cosine similarity. The browser runs the same pinned model locally. No query goes to an inference service.

What was measured

40 author-written EN/JA queries against 20 source-reviewed Japanese paraphrases. No training or tuning on these queries. Full-corpus evaluation; UI station and freshness filtering can differ. Not a real-user or OCR benchmark.

Each query has one or more relevant notice IDs fixed before the evaluation run. Hit@k measures whether any relevant notice appears in the first k results. MRR is the reciprocal rank of the first relevant result. Scores are not probabilities.

Failures are part of the result

  • When can I get five times WAON rewards?: first result waon-double; expected waon-bonus.
  • Is AEON's five percent off day valid at My Basket?: first result waon-double; expected waon-no-sale.
  • How much is one Rakuten point worth at SEIYU?: first result welcia-base; expected seiyu-earn.
  • Which payment stops me receiving Keio rewards?: first result sanwa-cash; expected keio-card.
  • 現金を使うと食品を安く買える会員制度はありますか: first result ok-card; expected ok-cash.
  • まいばすでポイントが五倍になるのはいつ: first result welcia-20; expected waon-bonus.
  • WAONの特典が二倍になる日に行きたい: first result welcia-20; expected waon-double.
  • まいばすで他社のクレカを使ってもポイントもらえる？: first result waon-redeem; expected waon-card.
  • 西友で楽天の貯めたポイントをいくらで使える: first result welcia-20; expected seiyu-earn.
  • ライフでdポイント払いした分にもポイントが付きますか: first result life-common; expected life-redeem.
  • ライフの電子マネー払いで追加ポイントはありますか: first result life-common; expected life-lacuca.
  • How can I spend my WAON balance for more value at Welcia?: first result waon-double; expected welcia-20.

Similar bonus notices and negated payment conditions can be confused. Always read the displayed conditions. Search never computes prices, eligibility or points; those remain source-reviewed facts and deterministic date rules.

Limits

This is a small, author-written smoke benchmark. Queries and Japanese paraphrases were created by the same project, so author bias and wording overlap remain. No independent labels, confidence calibration, held-out-store validation, price extraction, flyer OCR or field trial has been completed. Nationwide coverage and substantial model development remain future work.

CPU median query inference: 6 ms after model load. This is a local Python measurement, not a browser speed promise. Browser startup downloads roughly 135 MB of tokenizer/model assets plus runtime files.

Reproduce the result

python -m pip install --target .python -r requirements.txt
python scripts/download_model.py
python scripts/embeddings.py
python scripts/evaluate.py
node scripts/build.mjs
node --test tests/rules.test.mjs
